sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [LOGIC] gs:IMO26_005_ShipShape / sh:property[nltl:intendedAreaSuitabilityApprovalStatus]: The requirement applies the approved suitability status to every heading-reference and position-fixing system, but the candidate constrains only one ship-level approval-status value and does not associate each system with its intended area or approval status. Required change: Represent the systems as qualified resources or otherwise establish a per-system relationship, and require each system's intended-area suitability approval status to have exactly the approved value.

[OWNERSHIP_PATH] gs:IMO26_005_ShipShape/sh:property[nltl:headingOrPositionSystem]/sh:node: The candidate treats nltl:headingOrPositionSystem as a node carrying nested intended-area and approval-status properties, but the authoritative canonical term declares headingOrPositionSystem as an xsd:string DatatypeProperty. Consequently, the qualified constraints are attached to an incompatible value shape and do not constrain the canonical ship-owned properties correctly. Required change: Model nltl:headingOrPositionSystem consistently with its locked datatype and attach nltl:intendedArea and nltl:intendedAreaSuitabilityApprovalStatus through their authoritative ship-owned paths or an explicitly canonical qualified-system structure; do not apply sh:node with nested properties to the string-valued headingOrPositionSystem path.

[LOGIC] gs:IMO26_005_ShipShape properties for nltl:headingOrPositionSystem, nltl:intendedArea, and nltl:intendedAreaSuitabilityApprovalStatus: The three independent ship-level property constraints do not enforce that every individual heading-reference or position-fixing system has its corresponding intended area and Approved suitability status; they only require unrelated values to exist on the ship. Required change: Represent or constrain the per-system qualification relationship so that each applicable system is required to have its associated intended area and approval status equal to nltl:evidenceStateApproved. | [CARDINALITY] The sh:property constraint on nltl:intendedAreaSuitabilityApprovalStatus: sh:maxCount 1 on the ship-level approval-status path prevents multiple heading-reference or position-fixing systems from each having an approval status and is incompatible with the requirement's per-system scope. Required change: Remove the ship-level singleton restriction and apply status cardinality within the per-system qualification structure or path. | [MANDATORY_CONDITION] The sh:minCount 1 constraints on nltl:headingOrPositionSystem, nltl:intendedArea, and nltl:intendedAreaSuitabilityApprovalStatus: The candidate adds an unconditional requirement that every ship have at least one such system, intended area, and approval status, whereas the normalized requirement only constrains every system that exists. Required change: Make these conditions conditional on applicable systems, or otherwise remove the added existence requirement unless an authoritative mandatory-system obligation is supplied.
No concrete blocking defect detected in the current candidate.
